title: NBN POI 4TOB (Toowoomba) 4WOB (Woolloongabba) NNI Rehoming
current_summary: We will rehome NBN services from the Toowoomba (4TOB) and Woolloongabba (4WOB) POIs to a new router. This planned work is scheduled between 12:00 AM and 2:00 AM AEST on 12 August 2026. Services connected via these POIs may be disrupted for up to 2 hours during the window. Our team will work to minimise any downtime.

updates.content:
We will be performing planned network works to rehome NBN services from the Toowoomba (4TOB) and Woolloongabba (4WOB) POIs to a new router. The maintenance window is from 12:00 AM to 2:00 AM AEST on 12 August 2026. Services connected via these POIs may be disrupted for up to 2 hours during this window. We will work to keep any interruption as brief as possible.

If your service does not restore after the window, please power-cycle your modem/router and test again.
